digest.component_or_area: observability metrics and CloudWatch alarming for autodeploy review drain check
propositions: review_interrupts metric is currently published without reason dimension, making it impossible for CloudWatch-only monitoring to distinguish bound-exceeded from signal-unavailable cases without shell access to the host

bound-exceeded indicates the bot's drain check is working but reviews are still in flight after DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX time; signal-unavailable indicates the health probe itself is broken and deploys run without drain checks — opposite remediations require separate alarms

observability.sh must emit two new dimensionless metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) by splitting journal patterns through the existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper while preserving the rolled-up review_interrupts total

monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms, each carrying only its own remediation and keeping the 900s/1-datapoint/Sum>0/notBreaching cadence to preserve sensitivity
new test must verify the metric split works correctly by driving real observability.sh over synthetic journal data and confirming the split counts sum to the rolled-up total
terraform apply in infra/terraform must be executed by an operator to replace the old single alarm with the two new reason-scoped alarms and activate the split in live infrastructure
